title: Hardware-Aware Conditional Code in Android Apps
title_zh: Android 应用中的硬件感知条件代码

paragraphs.en: 对5万个Android应用的大规模实证研究揭示硬件相关条件代码十分普遍，并构建其用途分类体系。 Android OS runs on a highly diverse set of devices, spanning entry-level phones and flagships with substantially different hardware characteristics, including memory capacity, processors, displays, cameras, and sensors. Through APIs, apps can query device information at runtime, such as memory, hardware features, and manufacturer, among other device properties, allowing developers to execute different code paths on different devices. Existing studies cover only specific compatibility bugs or brand-specific behavior; however, the broader use of hardware information in app logic has not been comprehensively explored. We address this question with a large-scale empirical study of hardware-related if statements in Android apps. We statically analyze 50,000 apps to identify the if statements whose conditions depend on the values of hardware-related APIs, and extract their conditions together with the code of their branches. Our results show that 95% of successfully analyzed apps contain at least one such statement, with an average of 74 per app, which suggests that hardware-related logic is widespread. We then apply an LLM-assisted open-coding process to the extracted code to build a structured taxonomy of the purposes behind hardware-related conditional code. The resulting characterization shows that developers use hardware information for feature availability checks, UI adaptation, emulator detection, device tiering, and resource management, among others.
paragraphs.zh: 对5万个Android应用的大规模实证研究揭示硬件相关条件代码十分普遍，并构建其用途分类体系。Android操作系统运行在高度多样的设备上，涵盖入门级手机和硬件特性差异显著的旗舰机型，这些特性包括内存容量、处理器、显示屏、摄像头和传感器。 应用可以通过API在运行时查询设备信息，例如内存、硬件特性和制造商等设备属性，从而使开发者能够在不同设备上执行不同的代码路径。 现有研究仅覆盖特定的兼容性缺陷或特定品牌的行为；然而，硬件信息在应用逻辑中的更广泛使用尚未得到全面探索。 我们通过对Android应用中硬件相关的if语句进行大规模实证研究来回答这一问题。 我们对5万个应用进行静态分析，以识别条件依赖于硬件相关API取值的if语句，并提取这些语句的条件及其分支的代码。 我们的结果显示，在成功分析的应用中，95%至少包含一条此类语句，平均每个应用包含74条，这表明硬件相关逻辑十分普遍。 随后，我们对提取的代码应用LLM辅助的开放编码过程，以构建硬件相关条件代码用途的结构化分类体系。 所得特征分析表明，开发者使用硬件信息进行功能可用性检查、UI适配、模拟器检测、设备分级和资源管理等。
